review_evidence: README identifies the repository as a Japanese translation of the official Lean Language Reference, built from Verso/Lean source so code examples are typechecked.
Direct inspection found 79 Lean files and 194 proposition declarations, including actual Nat, inductive-type, monad, simplifier, tactic, and recursive-definition theorem/example material.
Documentation provenance does not make these checked formal examples lossless noise; no file-level hard exclusion was established without removing useful formal prior-art content.
summary: Retain the Japanese Lean Language Reference translation because its Lean source contains extensive checked language examples and theorem snippets.
